name: Proxy Configuration Inspector
description: Read-only view of system proxy sources, PAC and inherited environment variables
help: Reads per platform: macOS system configuration, Windows WinINet (current user) and WinHTTP (default), and Linux GNOME settings; failures and unsupported desktops are labelled honestly instead of shown as direct.

Lists proxy variables inherited when ToolForge started; uppercase and lowercase variants are kept side by side. Refreshing system settings does not inject variables from other terminals into a running process.
Obvious format problems (empty host, out-of-range port) get hints; the raw configuration can be expanded, and exports are masked locally.
PAC URLs are shown but never fetched or executed; no WPAD discovery, no connectivity probing and no settings are changed.

statusHint.disabled: Addresses are present but the toggle is off; they apply only when enabled.
statusHint.notConfigured: This source has no proxy configuration.
statusHint.unsupported: This platform does not cover the source (Linux supports GNOME only in the first release; other desktops have no unified system proxy).

env.hint: These variables were inherited when ToolForge started; refreshing does not pick up variables set in other terminals afterwards.

errors.proxy.sc_unavailable: The macOS System Configuration service is unavailable
errors.proxy.wininet_failed: Reading the WinINet (current user) configuration failed
errors.proxy.winhttp_failed: Reading the WinHTTP default configuration failed
